shots.visual_event: The record completes: 317 nights earlier, young Arin stands hypnotized on the track as the Midnight Train approaches.
shots.dialogue_audio: Narrator: “The badge did not call the train for Meera.”

shots.visual_event: Meera tackles Arin clear and lands inside the open carriage; the door closes before he can reach her.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera in memory: “Don’t open the door!”

shots.visual_event: Present Arin confronts the Conductor in the corridor, holding the cracked badge like evidence.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “She took my place before I took hers.”

shots.visual_event: The Conductor’s ivory mask tilts; a human eye behind one slit is wet but controlled.
shots.dialogue_audio: Conductor: “The train recognizes sacrifice. It does not understand love.”

shots.visual_event: In the city, Meera’s school registration, bedroom photos, and messages begin blanking while she watches.
Tick projects a countdown from the notch in his ear: MEERA / 09 NIGHTS.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “When it reaches zero, only we will know she existed.”
